notes.title: Project Fished out!
notes.content:
Introduction

As you probably have seen already, Magnet Fishing Simulator has a new publisher-developer.

The game's development has been in full swing for some time, though! We have spent the last period refining key systems that will form the foundation of the gameplay. While we do not want to reveal too many details yet, we can reveal a few secrets about the features we are currently developing.


Development of Fishing Mechanics

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36544050/78d7fff151c3b3ebb8389c312bdc2b202d59813e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36544050/ea4bc4a9b9fb14076d670d67c3d8d7a2f4c7330d.jpg

One of our main goals is to provide players with a satisfying and engaging experience related to exploration and interaction with the game world. That is why we are focusing on a system that will allow players to retrieve various items from the water and further process them. Precise controls, realistic interaction of physics forces, and various challenges are just some of the elements we are trying to improve.

Player Hub and Restoration System

We want every item you find to have its own story and potential use. That is why we are creating a dedicated place where players will be able to restore the glory of found objects. This is where you will be able to see the results of your efforts and learn more about unique finds.

What's Next?
Our team is hard at work on more features that will make the game even more engaging. We will soon share more details about the fishing system and how to interact with found items. Stay tuned for updates, because the best is yet to come!

If you still haven't wishlisted and followed the game, now should be the time for it, as we will be sharing the best stuff from the game regularly:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151980/Magnet_Fishing_Simulator/

Here are some screenshots of beautiful scenery from one of the locations in game:
